name: Sharumi
source:
Sharumi is the only child of a wealthy family. Her father, Mr. [url=https://vndb.org/c61003]Maxim[/url], is a very influential businessman who has a very good relationship with the current government. Sharumi has a very stubborn, shrew, immature and childish kind of personality but unusually for people of her social status she also appears to be very kind towards her servants [url=https://vndb.org/c29769]Haresu[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c30063]Riru[/url]. Her strong sense of justice might just prove out to be fatal for her once Lieutenant [url=https://vndb.org/c29770]Prosper[/url]'s military unit stations themselves at her villa.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=17]MangaGamer[/url]]
